##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 25 May 2026 at 11:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure covers the area and much of Europe, with low pressure near Iceland.


##Wind##

Variable 1 to 3, settling North or Northwest 3 or 4 tonight, occasionally 5 in the west of the area later in the night and tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight or moderate later tonight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or Northwest 3 or 4 through the rest of tomorrow, occasionally 5 in the west of the area. Then veering East or Southeast 4 or 5 in all waters overnight into Wednesday, possibly occasionally 6 in places.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
